question: Pick 3 cards with rarity of uncommon, list down name these cards according to ascending order of it's ruling date.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY T2.date ASC LIMIT 3
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY T2.date ASC LIMIT 3

d.request: Pick 3 cards with rarity “uncommon” and list their names in ascending order of ruling date, including cards with no matching rulings record.
d.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'uncommon' ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 3;

b.request: List the names of three cards with `rarity = 'uncommon'`, ordered by their ruling dates from earliest to latest, including cards with no matching rulings record
b.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'uncommon' GROUP BY c.uuid ORDER BY MIN(r.date) IS NULL, MIN(r.date) ASC, c.name ASC LIMIT 3

c.sql: SELECT c.name FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'uncommon' GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name ORDER BY MIN(r.date) ASC, c.name ASC LIMIT 3;
